# Siamese Neural Networks for One-shot Image Recognition

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Gregory Koch, Richard Zemel, Ruslan Salakhutdinov  
**Year:** 2016  
**Journal:** ICML  
**DOI:** [10.1007/978-3-319-25058-8_6](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-25058-8_6)

## Abstract

We describe a method for one-shot image recognition using siamese neural networks.
